advisories.verifiability: Confirm simulation.R uses only var_base (line 6) and that removing the inert variables does not change any output.

summary: 4 advisories (1x P2, 3x P3). None threatens the core conclusion. The re-audit independently reproduced the method from-scratch (R + Python + a custom Bayesian Gibbs sampler), so the strongest advisory (ADV-001) is now purely about regenerating the EXACT shipped table, not about whether the result is trustworthy. ADV-002 to ADV-004 are documentation/clarity items.
